turns.text: ok need help planning tomorrow. sunday. its 10pm and im already behind lol
Happy to help. What's on your plate tomorrow, and are there any fixed times? Tell me the must-dos and when you want to be done by.

blocks: ops mgmt group project (tote flow model, due nov 20) needs like 4 hrs. harrowgate prep, second round video interview is monday 18th, need maybe 2.5 hrs. sunday meal prep rajma and rice, four containers, ~1.5 hrs. plus rest i guess

Here's a first pass:

| Time | Block |
|---|---|
| 9:00-10:30 | Meal prep: rajma and rice, four containers |
| 10:30-11:00 | Break, walk, food |
| 11:00-3:00 | Project: tote-flow model (two 2-hr chunks with a 15 min break) |
| 3:00-4:00 | Real rest, no screens |
| 4:00-6:30 | Harrowgate prep: spoken answers out loud |
| 6:30-7:30 | Dinner |
| 7:30-8:30 | Light review, then stop |

Does that fit, or do you have other fixed things?
thx. but be realistic, i wont be asleep before 1 and im up at 6 for stuff, so like 5 hrs of sleep. fit it around that. also gotta keep it quiet in the apt, my roommate sleeps in till his shift later

Planning around about five hours of sleep is doable for a day, though it'll leave less slack before an interview. Here's the version built around 1 a.m. to 6 a.m.:

| Time | Block |
|---|---|
| 6:30-8:00 | Quiet start: project work with headphones |
| 8:00-9:30 | Meal prep (do chopping and pressure cooker early, keep it low-noise) |
| 9:30-10:00 | Break |
| 10:00-12:00 | Project, second chunk |
| 12:00-1:00 | Lunch plus a 20 min nap |
| 1:00-3:00 | Project wrap-up |
| 3:00-4:00 | Rest |
| 4:00-6:30 | Harrowgate prep, out loud |
| 6:30-7:30 | Dinner |
| 7:30-9:00 | Light review |
| 9:00-1:00 | Free/wind-down |

For the spoken practice, you could use headphones and a low voice, or go to a library or outdoors so you aren't worrying about noise. Want me to play the interviewer during the 4:00 block?
yes pls. also my usual saturday run route is messed up, ulloa boardwalk flooded after the storm so i did the delgado park loop this morning. is that fine to keep doing or should i wait

Delgado Park loop is a solid choice. Flooded boardwalks stay slick and can have debris even after water drains, so I'd keep using the park loop until the boardwalk is dry and clear. Check the trail's status before going back, and wear shoes with good grip when you do.

For tomorrow, a short easy walk fits well in the 9:30 break. Ready to start the interview practice whenever you are. Send your first answer for "tell me about yourself," or I'll ask the first question now.
